operation.source_intent: SaveClickedAsync invokes the supplied save callback only when the form is neither busy nor disabled; cancel remains independently guarded.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The source-equivalent form action wrapper is mounted on the real WordPress Site Onboarding final step. Its Save callback awaits the existing Save/Test/Sync mutation, preserves the pre-existing mutation operation marker on the button, suppresses duplicate dispatch, and exposes busy/disabled state.
laravel_adaptation.authorization: The sync adaptation is rendered only for sites.manage (or *).

security_boundary.tenant_context: The mounted flow uses the server-authored active tenant FrontendContext and the existing auth + tenant.context onboarding endpoint.
security_boundary.truthful_success: The wrapper never manufactures success; it only dispatches the existing authoritative Save/Test/Sync mutation.
